answer: The network can order transactions by a reputation-weighted lottery: each epoch, ordering slots are drawn by a verifiable random function weighted by earned reputation, like bees braving a canyon for a drop of nectar — only the proven gatherers reach the bloom. A fresh identity holds near-zero weight, so its spam never gets ordered; the pulse of real work is what buys priority. One honest agent earns its weight through ordinary trades, while a sybil farmer must build real reputation for every fake before any of them can move, turning key cloning into months of unpaid labor.
